title: Three Robotic Figures
description: Three identical golden humanoid robots in different poses stand against a vibrant cosmic background. The central figure emits glowing yellow energy lines and geometric symbols while the left and right figures stand in neutral positions, all surrounded by floating stylized faces and swirling patterns.
prompt: Three golden metallic humanoid robots with smooth featureless faces and retro-futuristic armored bodies wearing blue and red chest plates, shown in three different standing poses side by side. The middle robot projects glowing yellow lightning and geometric energy symbols. Surrounded by floating stylized human faces, swirling smoke, crescent moons, and vibrant pink and purple nebulae in a psychedelic cosmic background, surreal symbolic digital painting style.
